title: Charge finite mixed-cell loss and retain the paired-resistance work boundary
statement: For the producer nonideal finite-cycle carbonate model,the reported paired effective resistance-work law includes finite reset exchange/downtime;coarse gas contacts and fine electrical subdivision are distinct resources. Its component ledger does not establish the delivered plant target.

requires: The source local-equilibrium nonideal Gibbs model,full carbon/ion/water/charge accounting,finite mixed-cell transitions and actual reset exchange/downtime. Thermodynamic/transport/electrode coefficients remain source model inputs.

Frozen modeled state18.4064degC,176 electrical sections,11/106 capture/release gas contacts,six phase-staggered modules and complete paired effective R_pair in ohm cm^2 at the operating current,including membrane/electrode irreversible contributions. R_pair is not a membrane-only resistance or a high-frequency impedance intercept.
provides: Finite mixed-cell loss is W_cell-DeltaG=G(x_in)-G(x_out)-gradG(x_out).(x_in-x_out)>=0 for convex G. The reported finite-step staging calculation/equal thermodynamic-length allocation can reduce leading dissipation by electrical subdivision without adding an air exposure;no priority claim for those general concepts.

The reported law is W_cell=21.187829786+2.949298663 R_pair kJ/mol CORE net CO2. At the proposed unmeasured R_pair=4.259575,the electrochemical term is33.750589. At the older6.973950 scenario,cell plus existing utilities already gives61.85254 before later control/reset/drying.

The frozen source state uses1.736669 electrons/core net CO2,active17.601120mA/cm^2,1863.803s active,25.159s reset and98.6681%duty. Core average10mA/cm^2 includes internal membrane/reset exchanges,not all external carbon losses,shunts or auxiliary electrolysis area.

Reported component terms33.750589+20.096446+2.390462+2.267379+0.288736 give58.793611kJ/mol core net CO2. Earlier auxiliary estimates add1.07945 for illustrative INCOMPLETE59.87306. Missing routing and its recoupled chemistry/pressure/current prevent treating this as a <=60 delivered-CO2 plant.
assumptions: The target feed420ppm wet CO2,25degC,1bar,50%RH,50%removal;dry product>=99%CO2,1bar,<=100ppm water;all-cycle/all-installed-area10mA carbon-equivalent current and<=60kJ/mol DELIVERED CO2 are target boundaries,not demonstrated operation.
Reported numerical conservation/Gibbs closure and calibration to source solution data test the model,not joint hardware coefficients. No hardware was fabricated.
costs: The favorable electrode scenario requires6.5S/m ionic and100S/m electronic conductivity,specified carbonate transport and only0.5ohm cm^2 for combined kinetics/contacts/hysteresis,or8.80mV at the modeled current. Those properties are not jointly demonstrated.

The reported0.680mol/L source value is gas-measured CO2 capacity,NOT measured alkalinity or charge. The3.4F/m^2 charge-window notation is retained as an engineering inference from that proxy,thickness scaling and assumed utilization,not a measured cold continuously accessible operating window.

Reported one-tonne/day passive resources are254m^2 main separator,326000m^2 air-contact surface,36m^3 reset/conditioning storage and9.18m^3/day prepared water. High active-area target flux is not compactness or low cost.

Source comparator132kJ/mol and0.19mol/m^2/h refers to a9x300cm^2 pilot over48h;5000h belongs to a separate smaller device. Target3.731mol/m^2/h/about19.6x pilot flux is a target comparison,not demonstrated superiority.
contract.units: kJ/mol CORE net versus DELIVERED CO2;ohm cm^2 complete paired resistance;electrical current density,all-area duty,water/air/storage/utility resources.
contract.obstruction: The attempted manifold cases0.5/0.8/1.2/2.0L/m^2 per side have reported minimum surface clearances+17.27/-29.10/-87.89/-117.46micrometres versus required30micrometre solid wall;the latter three intersect,and terminal combs also cross opposite fingers without supplied layers/vias. These hydraulic-network calculations retain conditional value but their physical routing interpretation is rejected. This is failure of the attempted geometries,not a no-go for every routing design. A larger real manifold changes retained volume,reset exchange/downtime and current;pressure also changes water transport and reciprocal electrical work. Merely adding a pump-energy estimate does not close delivered performance. Proposed ionic/electronic/kinetic properties and modeled displacement response remain unmeasured together. Source comparator pilot energy/flux and separate long-duration smaller-device records stay separate;target flux is not demonstrated superiority. Mathematical/numerical consistency is not physical coefficient validation,practical compactness or historical priority.
